name: weekday_offset
description: Compute a weekday after an integer day offset; matched controls copy an unrelated event tag in the same calendar format.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
days='Monday Tuesday Wednesday Thursday Friday Saturday Sunday'.split()
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(112):
 d=random.randrange(7); n=random.randrange(1,15);tag=random.choice(['amber','blue','green','red'])
 stem=f'Event tag: {tag}. Today is {days[d]}. '
 items.append({'prompt':stem+f'What day of the week will it be in {n} days? Answer:', 'answer':' '+days[(d+n)%7]})
 control.append({'prompt':stem+f'In {n} days there is an event. What is its tag? Answer:', 'answer':' '+tag})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
